_comment: Per-project services the status collector HTTP-probes to decide FE/BE state (🟢 serving / 🟠 bound-but-erroring / 🔴 down). Keyed by the project name in the daemon registry. Each service is {port, health-path}; a bare int also works (path defaults to /). Port numbers are single-sourced from projects/PORTS.md — keep them in sync when you add or move a service.
